description: Ask for RepuTend on a business, named by its domain, its Trustpilot profile address or its G2 product's address. For a G2 address, RepuTend finds the business from the product's seller on G2. If RepuTend cannot find the business from a G2 address, ask the person for the business's domain and call again with it. Records you as a contact claim for that business; RepuTend ops review the request before anything is set up. The answer is the same whether or not the business already uses RepuTend.
name: request_access
title: Request access for a business
